mapper.select: /* master.mpst.selectAgingGrList */ SELECT #{st_yyyymm} AS YYYYMM, C.SITE, DECODE(C.SITE, 'IT', 'IT유통', 'KW', '유통', 'WM', '구매대행') AS SITE_NAME, C.KEP_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = C.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, NVL(C.D01_AMT, 0) AS D01_AMT, NVL(C.D02_AMT, 0) AS D02_AMT, NVL(C.D03_AMT, 0) AS D03_AMT, NVL(C.D04_AMT, 0) AS D04_AMT, NVL(C.D05_AMT, 0) AS D05_AMT, NVL(C.D06_AMT, 0) AS D06_AMT, NVL(C.D07_AMT, 0) AS D07_AMT, NVL(C.D08_AMT, 0) AS D08_AMT, NVL(C.D09_AMT, 0) AS D09_AMT, NVL(C.D10_AMT, 0) AS D10_AMT, NVL(C.D11_AMT, 0) AS D11_AMT, NVL(C.D12_AMT, 0) AS D12_AMT, NVL(C.ETC_AMT, 0) AS ETC_AMT, NVL(C.STOCK_AMT, 0) AS STOCK_AMT, NVL(C.BF_M_STOCK_AMT, 0) AS BF_M_STOCK_AMT, NVL((C.STOCK_AMT - C.BF_M_STOCK_AMT), 0) AS INCR, DECODE(C.BF_M_STOCK_AMT, 0, NULL, NVL(ROUND(((C.STOCK_AMT - C.BF_M_STOCK_AMT) / C.BF_M_STOCK_AMT) * 100, 1), 0)) AS INCR_RATE FROM ( SELECT B.SITE, B.KEP_DEPT, ROUND(SUM(B.D01_AMT) / 1000000) AS D01_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D02_AMT) / 1000000) AS D02_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D03_AMT) / 1000000) AS D03_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D04_AMT) / 1000000) AS D04_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D05_AMT) / 1000000) AS D05_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D06_AMT) / 1000000) AS D06_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D07_AMT) / 1000000) AS D07_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D08_AMT) / 1000000) AS D08_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D09_AMT) / 1000000) AS D09_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D10_AMT) / 1000000) AS D10_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D11_AMT) / 1000000) AS D11_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.D12_AMT) / 1000000) AS D12_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.ETC_AMT) / 1000000) AS ETC_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.STOCK_AMT) / 1000000) AS STOCK_AMT, ROUND(SUM(B.BF_M_STOCK_AMT) / 1000000) AS BF_M_STOCK_AMT FROM ( SELECT A.SITE, A.KEP_DEPT, A.D01_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D01_AMT, A.D02_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D02_AMT, A.D03_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D03_AMT, A.D04_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D04_AMT, A.D05_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D05_AMT, A.D06_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D06_AMT, A.D07_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D07_AMT, A.D08_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D08_AMT, A.D09_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D09_AMT, A.D10_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D10_AMT, A.D11_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D11_AMT, A.D12_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS D12_AMT, ((A.D13_QTY + A.ETC_QTY) * A.STOCK_PRICE) AS ETC_AMT, A.STOCK_QTY * A.STOCK_PRICE AS STOCK_AMT, (SELECT STOCK_QTY * STOCK_PRICE FROM KEP_STOCK_AGING_IPGO WHERE 1=1 AND YYYYMM = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AND SITE = A.SITE AND ITEM_NO = A.ITEM_NO ) AS BF_M_STOCK_AMT FROM KEP_STOCK_AGING_IPGO A WHERE A.YYYYMM = #{st_yyyymm} ) B GROUP BY B.SITE, B.KEP_DEPT ) C ORDER BY C.SITE, KEP_DEPT_NAME

/* master.mpst.selectLongTermStckIncrList */ SELECT #{st_yyyymm} AS YYYYMM, SITE, SITE_NAME, DEPT_NAME AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, CATEG_NAME AS ITEM_TYPE, SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM'), STOCK_QTY, 0)) AS BF_M_STOCK_QTY, ROUND(SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM'), STOCK_AMT, 0)) / 1000000) AS BF_M_STOCK_AMT, SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, #{st_yyyymm}, STOCK_QTY, 0)) AS STOCK_QTY, ROUND(SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, #{st_yyyymm}, STOCK_AMT, 0)) / 1000000) AS STOCK_AMT, SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, #{st_yyyymm}, STOCK_QTY, 0)) - SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM'), STOCK_QTY, 0)) INCR_QTY, ROUND((SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, #{st_yyyymm}, STOCK_AMT, 0)) - SUM(DECODE(YYYYMM, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM'), STOCK_AMT, 0))) / 1000000) AS INCR_AMT FROM ( SELECT YYYYMM, SITE, DECODE(SITE, 'WM', '구매대행(3M 초과)', 'IT', 'IT유통(6M초과)', '유통(6M 초과)') AS SITE_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = X.KEP_DEPT) AS DEPT_NAME, F_SPLIT(CATEG_NAME, ' > ', 2) AS CATEG_NAME, CASE WHEN SITE = 'WM' THEN STOCK_QTY - (D01_QTY + D02_QTY + D03_QTY) ELSE STOCK_QTY - (D01_QTY + D02_QTY + D03_QTY + D04_QTY + D05_QTY + D06_QTY) END AS STOCK_QTY, CASE WHEN SITE = 'WM' THEN STOCK_QTY * STOCK_PRICE - (D01_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D02_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D03_QTY * STOCK_PRICE) ELSE STOCK_QTY * STOCK_PRICE - (D01_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D02_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D03_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D04_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D05_QTY * STOCK_PRICE + D06_QTY * STOCK_PRICE) END AS STOCK_AMT FROM KEP_STOCK_AGING_IPGO X WHERE YYYYMM BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AND #{st_yyyymm} ) WHERE STOCK_QTY != 0 GROUP BY SITE, SITE_NAME, DEPT_NAME, CATEG_NAME ORDER BY SITE_NAME DESC, DEPT_NAME, BF_M_STOCK_AMT DESC
